title: Best Damn YouTube Comments Scraper input
description: Paste YouTube video, Shorts or channel URLs. Every comment (and reply, if enabled) delivered is one billable result; videos that cannot be read are reported free of charge.

startUrls.title: YouTube URLs
startUrls.description: One per line. Accepts video URLs (youtube.com/watch?v=..., youtu.be/...), Shorts and live URLs, bare 11-character video IDs, and channel URLs (youtube.com/@handle, youtube.com/channel/UC...) or @handles. For a channel, the Actor reads its most recent videos (see "Videos per channel").

maxComments.title: Max comments per video
maxComments.description: Stop after this many comments per video (replies count toward the limit). Use 0 for every comment the video has.

sortBy.title: Sort order
sortBy.description: "Top comments" is YouTube's relevance order (what viewers see first). "Newest first" is reverse chronological and is the fastest way to get only recent comments together with "Only comments after".

includeReplies.title: Include replies
includeReplies.description: Also return the replies under each comment, in conversation order, marked with isReply and parentCommentId.

publishedAfter.title: Only comments after
publishedAfter.description: Optional. Skip comments posted before this date. Use a date (2026-01-31) or a relative period such as "7 days", "2 weeks" or "3 months".

searchTerms.title: Only comments containing
searchTerms.description: Optional. Return only top-level comments that contain these words (YouTube's own comment search).

authorData.title: Author data
authorData.description: What to output about each commenter. "Include" gives the public display name and channel; "Pseudonymise" replaces the channel ID with a stable hash and drops name and avatar, so you can still count repeat commenters; "Omit" removes all author fields.

maxVideosPerChannel.title: Videos per channel
maxVideosPerChannel.description: For channel URLs: how many of the channel's most recent uploads to read comments from.

apiKey.title: YouTube API key
apiKey.description: Optional. Your own free YouTube Data API v3 key (Google Cloud Console > APIs & Services > Credentials, with the YouTube Data API v3 enabled). Without it the Actor uses a shared key whose daily quota is shared by all users; your own key gives you 10,000 quota units a day (about a million comments).

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many videos to read in parallel.
